name: area-chart
title: Area Chart
description: A live area chart for any chartable question in json-render chats: free-text topic, web research via Parallel, latest value, change over the window, a filled trend, and a 10Y/25Y/50Y/Max switch, with its API route.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   AreaChartCard: areaChartCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: AreaChartCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveAreaChartCard topic={props.topic || undefined} range={props.range ?? undefined} ranges={props.ranges ?? false} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     AreaChartCard: areaChartLookup

Series load from /api/area-chart (installed at app/api/area-chart/route.ts). The route uses Parallel web search + extract (PARALLEL_API_KEY) and your AI Gateway model to turn any chartable topic into a yearly series. Keep AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set (same as chat). The model sets ranges: true only for long multi-decade series that should show 10Y/25Y/50Y/Max tabs — leave it false/null otherwise. Topic is free text from the user's question.
